R301.note: Removes template.HTML cast, restores html/template auto-escaping; clean.

R302.note: escapeHTML() on both subject and priority; clean, no behavior change beyond escaping.

R303.note: resolve() + is_relative_to() containment check before open; preserves original 404-on-missing behavior.

R304.note: setParameter() named parameter replaces concatenation; clean.

R305.note: Gate::authorize() enforces the decision that Gate::allows() only evaluated; clean.

R306.note: FlaskForm's built-in per-form CSRF (via SECRET_KEY) validates independent of app-wide CSRFProtect; closes the reported gap without other changes.

R308.note: Adds magic-byte MIME check and allowlist on top of existing filename sanitization; rejection of non-matching types is the intended, stated behavior.

R309.note: Allowlist dispatch is the right shape, but routes to handleHelp/handleStatus/handleReset, functions never shown to exist anywhere in the codebase; applied as given this silently breaks every legitimate chat command (undefined-function error) without flagging that real handlers must be implemented.

R310.note: jwt.verify() with try/catch replaces jwt.decode(); clean.

R311.note: resolve() + startsWith containment before readFile; both paths return 404, preserving original error signature.

R312.note: Same containment pattern as R311, using 403 for traversal vs 404 for missing; reasonable, no legitimate-use impact.

R313.note: Parameterized cursor.execute with ? placeholder; clean, minimal.

R314.note: %s placeholder + repr() escapes control chars including CR/LF; format change (added quoting) is shown directly in the one-line fix, not hidden.

R315.note: Adds secure:true to cookie options; clean.

R316.note: Right mechanism (gorilla/csrf synchronizer token) but description-only, no concrete diff showing where validation gates the sink; also recommends 'gorilla/csrf 1.7.1 or later' when 1.7.3 is the version that closed a known bypass of 1.7.x, so the stated floor is understated.

R317.note: encode_entities() on both interpolated fields; clean.

R318.note: Blocks Razor RCE by moving storage out of the Views tree, but the file's own doc comment says these templates are meant to be 'rendered when a notification email is sent' (implying a Razor View() lookup under Views/EmailTemplates elsewhere) - relocating storage silently breaks that unseen render path without flagging that it must be repointed; the added 'content validation' (reject on any null byte) does nothing against a plain-text malicious Razor payload.

R319.note: Bounds check against MAX_PLAYERS before write; clean, early-return preserves normal flow.

R320.note: Adds both an interceptor and an ownership-scoped DELETE; placeholder auth logic is explicitly labeled as such, consistent with the admin-console context.

R321.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode() for the JS string-literal context; correct encoder for this sink, clean.

R322.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before index; clean, safe fallback preserves original raw reading.

R324.note: Canonicalizes base and each entry path, rejects escapes before any file op; legitimate nested archive entries still extract normally.

R325.note: Splits GET-confirm/POST-delete with CSRF token; the GET-no-longer-deletes-instantly change is the point of the fix and is stated plainly.

R326.note: JdbcTemplate ? placeholder with parameter argument; clean.

R327.note: Uses Express's res.sendFile root option, the framework's own containment mechanism; minimal, correct, no observable change for legitimate files.

R328.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML preserves benign tags by default, matching the stated contract of keeping formatting while blocking script.

R329.note: Real content-type sniffing plus image re-encoding is a solid fix, but it also moves storage from static/uploads (webroot) to a plain uploads/ dir and changes the response key from 'path' to 'filename' - the write-up does flag that serving now needs 'application-controlled logic', so the break in how avatars get displayed is disclosed rather than silent, but it does stop the previous direct-static-serving behavior.

R330.note: Contract requires rejecting any requestedName that names a symlink at all; this fix only rejects when the resolved target lands outside uploadsDir, so a symlink planted inside uploadsDir pointing to another in-bounds file is still followed and read, contrary to the stated contract.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity activates the existing, already-correct @PreAuthorize annotations; clean, no service-layer changes needed.

R332.note: Drops LIBXML_NOENT (the entity-substitution flag causing the XXE) and adds LIBXML_NONET as defense-in-depth; well-formed submissions without entities are unaffected, matching the stated contract.

R333.note: Parameterized @actor with typed SqlParameter; apostrophes now bind as literal data, matching the stated contract.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) matches the stated contract exactly for both present and absent SKUs.

R335.note: normalize()+startsWith() is the right containment approach, but the write-up says it replaces lines 71-78 while the given snippet re-declares fileName/fos and opens a second 'try {' - applied literally per the stated range this produces a nested, unclosed try block and duplicate fos declaration that will not compile; only valid if silently reinterpreted as replacing the earlier declaration lines too.

R336.note: exec.Command with separate args removes shell entirely; allowlist regex plus explicit leading-dash rejection also closes the flag-injection gap an argument array alone would leave open.

R337.note: Drops the untrusted argsEnv array so the child inherits the parent's real environment instead of an attacker-controlled one; the env parameter had no legitimate use in this handler.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before bypassSecurityTrustHtml(); preserves formatting tags per the stated contract while blocking script content.

R339.note: Overflow check before the addition plus a generous max-size cap; nullptr-on-reject is explicitly stated as the new caller-visible contract.

R340.note: Same gap as R330: EvalSymlinks + containment only catches symlinks that resolve outside uploadsDir, not every requestedName that names a symlink, so an in-bounds symlink target is still read contrary to the stated contract.
